learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn to develop mathematical thinking.
Students will learn to provide the ability to solve differential equations.
Students will learn to solve problems encountered in mathematics, physics and engineering.
Students will gain a method to be used in scientific research.
Students will learn to solve many mathematical problems by setting up a differential equation model.

syllabus_topics: Definition and Classification of Differential Equations
Order and Degree of Differential Equations
Solutions of Differential Equations: Integral Curve, Implicit-Explicit Solution, Particular Solution, General Solution, Singular Solution, Initial Value Problem
Derivation of Differential Equations
First Order Differential Equations: Separable Differential Equations
Differential Equations Reducible to Separable Differential Equations
Homogeneous Functions
Homogeneous Differential Equations
Differential Equations Reducible to Homogeneous Form
Linear Equations
Integrating Factors Method
Method of Variation of Parameters
Bernoulli Differential Equations
Exact Differential Equations and Integrating Factors
Integrating Factors Method Involving a Single Variable
Riccati Differential Equations
Clairaut and Lagrange Equations from Higher Degree First Order Differential Equations
Higher Order Linear Differential Equations: Homogeneous Differential Equations with Constant Coefficients
Characteristic Equation
General Solutions of Linear Homogeneous Equations
Linear Independence and Wronskian Determinant
Complex Roots of the Characteristic Equation
Real-Valued Solutions
Repeated Roots
Non-Homogeneous Equations
Method of Undetermined Coefficients
Method of Variation of Parameters (Variation of Constant - Lagrange)
Euler Differential Equation with Variable Coefficients
Some Special Second Order Differential Equations: Differential Equations Not Containing the Dependent Variable
Differential Equations Not Containing the Independent Variable
Series Solutions of Second Order Linear Differential Equations: Brief Review of Power Series
Series Solution Around an Ordinary Point
Laplace Transform, Definition of Laplace Transform
Inverse Laplace Transform, Definition of Inverse Laplace Transform
Solution of Initial Value Problems using Laplace Transform
First Order Linear Systems of Differential Equations: Elimination and Determinant Method
